name: agent-agentic-os
description: Governed control plane and learning layer above Claude Code: a gated task pipeline with signed human approval gates and a gating switch (running-control-plane), project setup and signing-identity guidance (setting-up-agentic-os), and eval-gated skill improvement in an isolated lab (improving-skills-in-lab).

name: agent-orchestration
description: Composable agent loop and graph architectures — deterministic state machines, DAG workflows, supervisor/worker loops, and parallel swarms, paired with the multi-LLM task router suite (run_agent.py, 13 expert agent personas, AGT sandboxing, and MAF validation). Framework-agnostic: works with any CLI agent.

name: agent-memory
description: Agent Memory & Knowledge: filesystem memory, RLM summary ledgers, vector retrieval, and Obsidian vault and wiki workflows.

name: agent-extension-authoring
description: Ecosystem authoring primitives — creates and audits agent skills, plugins, sub-agents, instructions, rules, hooks, GitHub workflows, and APM packages.

name: dev-utils
description: Unified Developer Utilities Suite. Collection of stateless tools for context bundling, diagram rendering, Kanban board task management, ADR auditing, text humanization, and markdown link verification.

name: agent-exploration-cycle
description: Business exploration and reengineering: guided discovery, requirements capture, interactive prototypes, risk-tiered handoff to engineering, and rescue of existing vibe-coded prototypes. Phase gates enforced by running-exploration-cycle.
